decisions.reason: Two-component resin injection units are core to the firm's plural-component portfolio and continue to serve industrial customers.
This second injection unit model complements the product range and is expected to retain steady demand.
Automatic airless spray guns are established standard products in the coating equipment line.
Manual airless spray guns remain a basic, reliable offering with consistent replacement demand.
The air-assisted airless line with multiple models covers a broad market segment and should be kept.
As a data logger for coating equipment it holds value for digital service offerings, though slightly higher drop risk as a supporting accessory.
